title: ACute Uncomplicated Type b Aortic Dissection: Endovascular Repair vs. Best Medical Therapy
official: A Randomized Controlled Comparative Study on Effectiveness of Endovascular Repair Versus Best Medical Therapy for Acute Uncomplicated Type B Aortic Dissection
summary: The purpose of the study is to conduct a randomized controlled trial comparing best medical therapy (BMT) alone to BMT with thoracic endovascular aortic repair (BMT+TEVAR) for uncomplicated acute type B aortic dissection.
